CustomField.description: Google Maps link built from Check Out Geo.
CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK("https://www.google.es/maps/dir/" & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Geo__Latitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Geo__Latitude__s)) & "," & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Geo__Longitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Geo__Longitude__s)) & "/" & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Geo__Latitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Geo__Latitude__s)) & "," & IF(ISBLANK(Check_Out_Geo__Longitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_Out_Geo__Longitude__s)), "Click On This URL")
CustomField.label: Check Out Location
